description: User story under REQ-190 for the administrative Finalise (FBS-220). rcf build finalise reads the report, checks preconditions and provenance and writes verified; it spawns no verify subprocess and no agent CLI. Every refusal names its reason, exits 4 (or 3 for validation, 2 for usage) and leaves the FBS unchanged.
asA: the stage-keeper, or any hand it names, after the merge
iWant: Finalise to be a deterministic check of recorded evidence that any worker can run
soThat: every merged spec reaches verified or a named refusal, and no merge waits on a session allowed to spawn an agent

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given an FBS at complete, HEAD containing the report head, every bound AC with a Code Node, and a valid VerifyReport with hand "verifier", verdict PASS with ship authority and finishedAt within 7 days, when rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref> runs, then executionStatus becomes verified, stdout carries "finalise: <fbs-id> verified from <report path> (head <sha7>, ci <ref>)", it exits 0, and no child process other than git is spawned.
acceptanceCriteria.supersessionNote: Retired 2026-10-24: Finalise no longer ingests a Test-stage report to write verified; it writes complete from the recorded verdicts of the last round (ADR ADR-4157, redesign change 1).

acceptanceCriteria.description: [failure] Given no report under rcf/verify-reports/<fbs-id>/ (and no --report), when rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref> runs, then it exits 4 with stderr "finalise refused: no Test-stage verify report for <fbs-id>; the verifier runs rcf verify run --fbs <fbs-id> --hand verifier before merge" and the FBS stays complete.
acceptanceCriteria.supersessionNote: Retired 2026-10-24: the missing-report refusal becomes the missing REVIEW verdict refusal (ADR ADR-4157).

acceptanceCriteria.description: [failure] Given a report whose headSha is neither an ancestor of HEAD nor tree-equal to a commit HEAD contains, when Finalise runs, then it exits 4 with "finalise refused: report head <sha7> is not contained in HEAD <sha7>; re-verify this head"; a finishedAt older than --max-report-age (default 7 days) exits 4 with "finalise refused: report is <n> days old".
acceptanceCriteria.supersessionNote: Retired 2026-10-24: report head containment is replaced by the reviewed head H and the rule that only REVIEW:, TEST: and FINALISE: commits follow it (ADR ADR-4157, rounds rule).

acceptanceCriteria.description: [failure] Given a report whose hand is not "verifier", or whose verifierId equals the Hand-Id trailer of any Hand: builder commit between the merge-base and HEAD, when Finalise runs, then it exits 4 with "finalise refused: report hand <hand>/<id> is not separate from the builder" and the FBS is unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria.supersessionNote: Retired 2026-10-24: report hand and Hand-Id provenance are replaced by the separation audit over the range (ADR ADR-4157, ADR ADR-4153).

acceptanceCriteria.description: [failure] Given --ci-run absent, the FBS not at complete, or a bound AC without a Code Node, when Finalise runs, then it exits 4 ("ci evidence missing: pass --ci-run <ref>"), 4 (the existing not-complete message) and 3 ("missing Code Nodes: <ac-ids>") respectively; a report that fails VerifyReport v1 validation exits 3 naming the field.
acceptanceCriteria.supersessionNote: Retired 2026-10-24: the not-complete precondition is gone (Finalise writes complete); the --ci-run and Code Node refusals carry over, slice-scoped (ADR ADR-4157).

acceptanceCriteria.description: [failure] Given a valid report whose perAc rows carry any verdict from [MOCK-ONLY-DECLARED | EVAL-MISSING | EVAL-BELOW-THRESHOLD | UI-BASELINE-UNMET | BROWSER-VERIFICATION-MISSING | SCOPE-MISMATCH], or whose verdict is not PASS or verdictAuthority is not ship, when Finalise runs, then it refuses exit 4 with the same message shapes 0.20.0 and 0.28.0 defined, read from the ingested report, and the FBS stays complete.
acceptanceCriteria.supersessionNote: Retired 2026-10-24: blocking per-criterion report verdicts are replaced by the TEST verdict and the test-strength record (ADR ADR-4157).

acceptanceCriteria.description: [failure] Given the retired flags, when rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --mode <any> or --url <url> runs, then it exits 2 with "finalise no longer runs verify; run rcf verify run --fbs <fbs-id> --hand verifier at the Test stage" and spawns nothing.
acceptanceCriteria.supersessionNote: Retired 2026-10-24: the retired-flag message now names the recorded verdicts instead of a Test-stage verify run (ADR ADR-4157).

acceptanceCriteria.description: [must-not] rcf build finalise never spawns rcf verify run, the verifier package or the agent CLI, and on every refusal leaves rcf/fbs/<fbs-id>.json byte-identical to its state before the run.

title: Finalise promotes to verified by ingesting the Test-stage report, with no agent spawn
